shadows.name: flat
shadows.purpose: shadow-xs and shadow-sm on controls: invisible but a valid box-shadow list member, so focus rings still paint.

shadows.purpose: Dropdown menus, popovers, hover cards, select lists.

shadows.purpose: Dialogs (the command palette and About), sheets, submenus.

shadows.value: paint-order: stroke fill; -webkit-text-stroke: 6px var(--color-plate); text-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--color-plate)
shadows.purpose: A plate-colored knockout under region names on the plate; not a shadow of elevation.

motion.name: ease-damped
motion.purpose: Camera eases, layout and gravity morphs, chevrons; no overshoot.

motion.name: develop
motion.purpose: Loading plate: each star fades and scales from 0.6 to 1 and back, on its own delay.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion collapses every animation and transition; morphs snap.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.note: Rail becomes a 288px sheet behind a 52px bar; record follows the work area.

focus.contrast: Solid ring 9.30:1 light, 10.96:1 dark; the 50% halo 2.56:1 light, 3.66:1 dark and is not relied on.

narrative.overview:
Skyplate treats a repository as an astronomical photographic plate and the report as the archive that catalogs it. The plate is the image: a dark glass field, identical in both themes, on which every file is a star. Everything around it is the catalog, set in silver-gelatin monochrome: a cool silver ground, white paper for the record and floating layers, ink text, and one-pixel hairlines. Because the chrome has no hue of its own, every hue on screen is a measured fact: a language, a category, a magnitude, a status, or the one reserved red.

The catalog vocabulary of the earlier Specimen Cabinet direction stays: files are specimens, directories are drawers, the most depended-on file in each region is its holotype, and the right column is the accession record. What changed is the material. The solid slate rail is gone (a big dark rail fought the plate for the eye); the rail is now a sleeve a half step below the ground. The plate is marked as a plate: registration corners and an inscription of commit, branch and date on the glass. The brand mark is a notched plate with one star under the same four-tick reticle the viewer draws on hover.

Type is Archivo on its width axis: condensed (88%) for the interface, tighter for headings and label stock, and at its widest (125%) only in the lowercase `skyplate` wordmark. JetBrains Mono carries paths, figures, hashes and dates. Surfaces sit flat; only layers that float over content take a shadow. Motion is damped, never overshoots, and collapses under reduced motion.
keyCharacteristics: Cool silver ground, white paper, ink; no chrome hue.
A dark glass plate in both themes, with registration corners and an inscription.
One red, reserved for holotypes; critical severity is ink.
Hairline rules instead of cards; flat at rest, shadows only on floating layers.
Archivo condensed for words, Archivo wide for the wordmark only, JetBrains Mono for data.
Small consistent corners: 6px controls, 8px plate insets, round data marks.
Damped motion, no overshoot; the loading plate develops its stars.

rules.name: The Holotype Reservation Rule
rules.body: Red means "this region's most depended-on file" and nothing else. Critical severity is ink, unfavorable deltas are serious orange, and no categorical slot is red.

rules.name: The Silver Chrome Rule
rules.body: The chrome has no hue. Primary actions, active rows, focus rings and the hover wash are ink, paper and gray; any hue on screen is data or a reserved signal.

rules.name: The Ink Text Rule
rules.body: Text never wears a data color. Labels, values and legend entries stay in ink tokens; identity rides on a swatch dot beside them.

rules.name: The Fixed Slot Rule
rules.body: Slot order is the color-vision-safety mechanism and is never reordered. Anything past slot 7 folds into series-other.

rules.name: The Surface Steps Rule
rules.body: Dark surfaces get their own validated steps (series-dark, dark-measure); light colors are never inverted or dimmed to fit. The plate always uses the dark steps.

rules.name: The Two Faces Rule
rules.body: Words are Archivo; paths, figures, hashes, dates and code are JetBrains Mono. No third family, and no system display face.

rules.name: The Width Axis Rule
rules.body: Interface text runs at 88% width; headings and label stock tighten to 75-85%. Width, not size, fits dense labels. 125% belongs to the wordmark alone.

rules.name: The Column Figures Rule
rules.body: Figures that align in columns are tabular. Figures inside running text stay in Archivo with tabular digits (MetaText), so a comma never gets a full mono cell.

rules.name: The Hairline Grid Rule
rules.body: Regions are separated by 1px rules in the rule color; no tray draws its own box. A chart with nothing to draw keeps its cell and says why.

rules.name: The No-Scroll Tray Rule
rules.body: Nothing inside a unit tray scrolls. Overflow folds into a count ("6 others").

rules.name: The Flat Tray Rule
rules.body: Anything that sits in the layout sits flat. A shadow means "floating above the page" and appears nowhere else.

rules.name: The Transparent Flat Rule
rules.body: Flat is a transparent zero shadow, never `none`: Tailwind composes shadow and focus ring into one box-shadow list, and a `none` in it voids the whole declaration.

rules.name: The Glass Backing Rule
rules.body: On the plate, occlusion uses the plate's own color (fills, halos), never a bordered panel or a shadow.

dos: Do keep the chrome monochrome: ink, paper, silver, wash and hairlines; let hue appear only on marks and reserved signals.
Do print primary actions, active states and focus in ink (focus ring Ink 2, solid 2px edge).
Do rule regions apart with 1px hairlines in the rule color instead of boxing them.
Do keep text in ink, Ink 2 or Ink 3 and put identity on a swatch dot beside it.
Do use the series-dark steps on the plate and in the dark theme, and dark-measure for single-series marks there.
Do ship direct labels or a table view with any chart that relies on light slots 2-5; they sit under 3:1 on the ground.
Do pair every status color with an icon and a label.
Do set paths, counts, hashes and dates in JetBrains Mono with tabular figures.
Do back plate chrome with the plate's own color, and halo text set over stars.
Do ease camera moves, chevrons and layout morphs with the damped curve (cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)), no overshoot; hover color changes take 150ms.
donts: Don't use holotype red for anything but a region's most depended-on file: not errors, critical severity, negative deltas or a chart series.
Don't give the chrome a hue: no navy or slate rail, no blue focus ring, no colored primary button.
Don't give in-layout surfaces (trays, rail, record, buttons, inputs) a shadow.
Don't wrap trays in bordered or rounded cards, or lay bordered panels over the plate.
Don't reorder the categorical slots or add a red slot.
Don't invert or dim light-surface colors to fit a dark surface.
Don't let the plate follow the theme; it is dark glass in both.
Don't round structural elements past 8px; full rounding is for data dots and round controls.
Don't set the wordmark's 125% width anywhere but the wordmark, or introduce a third typeface.
Don't reuse the inscription's uppercase "Plate" as a section label or eyebrow; it is part of the inscription only.
